content:
Here is the recipe JSON:
{
  "recipe_name": "Chicken Biryani",
  "ingredients": [
    "1 1/2 cups basmati rice",
    "1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs",
    "2 large onions, chopped",
    "2 cloves garlic, minced",
    "1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger",
    "1 teaspoon ground cumin",
    "1 teaspoon ground coriander",
    "1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder",
    "1/2 teaspoon red chili powder",
    "1/2 teaspoon garam masala powder",
    "1/2 teaspoon salt",
    "2 tablespoons ghee or vegetable oil",
    "2 cups chicken broth",
    "2 tablespoons plain yogurt",
    "Chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish"
  ],
  "steps": [
    {
      "step_number": 1,
      "instruction": "Rinse the rice in a fine mesh sieve until the water runs clear, then soak it in water for 30 minutes",
      "time": "30 minutes",
      "tip": "Use a large bowl to soak the rice"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 2,
      "instruction": "Heat 2 tablespoons of ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat, add the chopped onions and cook until they are lightly browned",
      "time": "8-10 minutes",
      "tip": "Stir the onions occasionally to prevent burning"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 3,
      "instruction": "Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "Be careful not to burn the garlic and ginger"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 4,
      "instruction": "Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder, garam masala, and salt to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "Stir well to combine the spices"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 5,
      "instruction": "Add the chicken to the saucepan and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through",
      "time": "6-8 minutes",
      "tip": "Use a thermometer to check the internal temperature of the chicken"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 6,
      "instruction": "Add the soaked and drained rice to the saucepan, along with the chicken broth and yogurt, and bring to a boil",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Stir well to combine the rice and liquid"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 7,
      "instruction": "Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed",
      "time": "15-20 minutes",
      "tip": "Do not lift the lid during the cooking time"
    },
    {
      "step_number": 8,
      "instruction": "Turn off the heat and let the biryani rest, covered, for 5 minutes, then fluff it with a fork and garnish with chopped cilantro",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Use a fork to fluff the biryani gently"
    }
  ]
}
i am making this for 5 people serves , how much salt should i put in here

For 5 people, you will need to multiply the ingredients by 2.5 (since the original recipe is for 2 people). 

The original recipe calls for 1/2 teaspoon of salt. For 5 people, you will need:

1/2 teaspoon x 2.5 = 1.25 teaspoons of salt

So, you should use approximately 1.25 teaspoons of salt. However, you can adjust the amount of salt to your taste. If you prefer less salty food, start with 1 teaspoon and add more to taste.
